title: Lower bound on chain hitting time
statement: For every natural number $n$ and rational number $B$, if the expected truncated hitting time of the last vertex in the chain digraph on $	ext{Fin}(n+1)$, starting from vertex $0$, is at most $B$ for every truncation length $N$, then $(2^n-1)/2\le B$.
hypotheses_covered: For every natural number N, the truncated hitting time from 0 to the last vertex in the chain digraph on Fin(n+1) is at most B
